reason: A broad DSH Web UI plugin and skin suite whose primary user-facing purpose is enhancing interface appearance and layout, with additional task automation, visualizations, mobile remote access, SSH operations, and image-understanding features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、侧边面板、任务看板、Git 可视化、移动端远程和 SSH 等界面与工作流扩展。
summaries.en: A pluggable DeepSeek Harness Web UI suite offering skins, side panels, task boards, Git visualizations, mobile remote access, SSH operations, and image-understanding tools.

capabilities: Adds configurable Web UI panels, skins, and visualizations
Provides task-board scheduling and execution through DSH agent sessions
Provides remote mobile and PC browser pairing with synchronized workspace access
Supports SSH terminal access, SFTP transfer, port forwarding, and multi-host command execution
Sends referenced images to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for analysis
